title: Cases for the last true bit
statement: For every finite Boolean word $v$, either $v$ contains no true bit and its cut at the last true bit is undefined, or $v$ contains a true bit and there is a word $u$ equal to that cut such that, for every prefix $pre$, the cut of $pre$ followed by $v$ is defined and equals $pre$ followed by $u$.
